```{=html}
<div class="survey" id="theil-survey">
  <p class="survey-q">How satisfied are you with the THEILUMINA website?</p>
  <div class="survey-faces" role="group" aria-label="Satisfaction rating from 1 (I don't like it) to 5 (I like it)">
    <button type="button" data-v="1"><span class="emo" aria-hidden="true">😞</span><span class="lab">I don't like it</span></button>
    <button type="button" data-v="2"><span class="emo" aria-hidden="true">🙁</span><span class="lab">Not much</span></button>
    <button type="button" data-v="3"><span class="emo" aria-hidden="true">😐</span><span class="lab">It's OK</span></button>
    <button type="button" data-v="4"><span class="emo" aria-hidden="true">🙂</span><span class="lab">Quite a lot</span></button>
    <button type="button" data-v="5"><span class="emo" aria-hidden="true">😄</span><span class="lab">I like it</span></button>
  </div>
  <p class="survey-thanks" hidden>Thank you for your opinion! You can also leave us a recommendation below.</p>
  <div class="survey-results" hidden></div>

  <form class="survey-reco" id="theil-reco">
    <label class="form-label" for="reco-text"><b>Recommendations</b>: what would you improve or add (data, guides, software, features)?</label>
    <textarea class="form-control" id="reco-text" rows="4" maxlength="2000" required></textarea>
    <div class="row g-2 mt-1">
      <div class="col-md-6"><input class="form-control" id="reco-email" type="email" placeholder="Your email (optional, if you would like a reply)"></div>
      <div class="col-md-6"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Send recommendation</button></div>
    </div>
    <p class="survey-sent" hidden>Thank you! Your recommendation has been sent.</p>
  </form>
  <p class="survey-note">Anonymous: no cookies or personal data are stored. Your rating is counted only once per browser.</p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  // ---- Settings ----
  const GC_CODE = "theilumina";          // GoatCounter code (same as the visit counter)
  const FORMSPREE_ID = "";               // Optional: Formspree form ID (e.g. "xyzabcd"). Empty = send by email
  const CONTACT_EMAIL = "jfmunoz@ugr.es";
  const KEY = "theilumina-survey-v1";
  const LABELS = ["I don't like it", "Not much", "It's OK", "Quite a lot", "I like it"];

  const box = document.getElementById("theil-survey");
  if (!box) return;
  const store = {
    get() { try { return localStorage.getItem(KEY); } catch (e) { return null; } },
    set(v) { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, v); } catch (e) {} }
  };
  const isLocal = ["localhost", "127.0.0.1"].includes(location.hostname);

  function count(path, title) {
    const go = () => window.goatcounter && window.goatcounter.count &&
      window.goatcounter.count({path: path, title: title, event: true});
    if (window.goatcounter && window.goatcounter.count) go(); else setTimeout(go, 2000);
  }

  async function showResults() {
    if (isLocal) return;
    const n = await Promise.all([1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(v =>
      fetch(`https://${GC_CODE}.goatcounter.com/counter/${encodeURIComponent("survey/satisfaction-" + v)}.json`)
        .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : {count: "0"})
        .then(d => parseInt(String(d.count).replace(/\D/g, ""), 10) || 0)
        .catch(() => 0)));
    const total = n.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    if (!total) return;
    const mean = n.reduce((a, b, i) => a + b * (i + 1), 0) / total;
    const res = box.querySelector(".survey-results");
    res.innerHTML = `<p><b>Results so far</b> (${total} rating${total > 1 ? "s" : ""}; average ${mean.toFixed(1)} out of 5)</p>` +
      n.map((c, i) => `<div class="sr-row"><span class="sr-lab">${["😞","🙁","😐","🙂","😄"][i]} ${LABELS[i]}</span>` +
        `<span class="sr-bar"><span style="width:${(100 * c / total).toFixed(1)}%"></span></span><span class="sr-n">${Math.round(100 * c / total)}%</span></div>`).join("");
    res.hidden = false;
  }

  function lock(v) {
    box.querySelectorAll(".survey-faces button").forEach(b => {
      b.disabled = true;
      if (b.dataset.v === String(v)) b.classList.add("chosen");
    });
    box.querySelector(".survey-thanks").hidden = false;
    showResults();
  }

  const prev = store.get();
  if (prev) lock(prev);
  box.querySelectorAll(".survey-faces button").forEach(b => b.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (store.get()) return;
    const v = b.dataset.v;
    count(`survey/satisfaction-${v}`, `Satisfaction ${v}/5: ${LABELS[v - 1]}`);
    store.set(v);
    setTimeout(() => lock(v), 400);
  }));

  document.getElementById("theil-reco").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = document.getElementById("reco-text").value.trim();
    const email = document.getElementById("reco-email").value.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    count("survey/recommendation", "Recommendation sent");
    if (FORMSPREE_ID) {
      try {
        const r = await fetch(`https://formspree.io/f/${FORMSPREE_ID}`, {
          method: "POST", headers: {"Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
          body: JSON.stringify({recommendation: text, email: email || "(not given)", rating: store.get() || "(no rating)", page: location.pathname})
        });
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
        e.target.querySelector(".survey-sent").hidden = false;
        e.target.reset();
        return;
      } catch (err) { /* if it fails, fall back to email */ }
    }
    const body = `Recommendation:\n${text}\n\nRating: ${store.get() || "(no rating)"}\nEmail: ${email || "(not given)"}`;
    window.location.href = `mailto:${CONTACT_EMAIL}?subject=${encodeURIComponent("[THEILUMINA] Website recommendation")}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
  });
})();
</script>
```
